context: Riku-teen tells Sho-young about his university campus visit.
purpose: Older teen sharing future hopes with younger.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.en: I went to visit the campus!
lines.style: Quick, excited opening—he can't wait to share. Warm, genuine enthusiasm. Natural conversational pace, leaning forward slightly in the voice. Light lift at the end.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.style: Immediate curiosity, eyes bright. Soft and genuinely interested—not performing. Leans in to listen. The pause before the question shows he's processing what Riku just said.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: 校舎、めっちゃ広かった!
lines.style: Bright, animated delivery. The scale of it still surprises him as he speaks. Energetic but not shouting—sharing the wonder. Slight emphasis on the size without overplaying.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.en: That's awesome—are you looking forward to it?
lines.style: Soft, fond question. There's warmth underneath—Sho genuinely asking because he cares, not just filling space. Small smile in the voice. Genuine curiosity about how Riku really feels.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: うん、めっちゃ楽しみや!
lines.style: Immediate, genuine affirmation. Bright, warm energy—no hesitation. The excitement is real and infectious. Slight lift and breathiness on the final words, like he can barely contain it.
